name: field
description: FIELD governance framework from Spin State Labs. Generate, validate, and audit FIELD governance manifests (Federated, Identity, Enforcement, Ledger, Delegation) for agentic AI via the /field slash command. v1.1 adds the Enforcement Gate: a PreToolUse hook that enforces the manifest at runtime (kill switch, protected paths, irreversible-action deny patterns, tool-call budget, hash-chained ledger). FIELD is design-time governance; FORCE is runtime prompt hygiene. They compose.
